A bold near-circular O made from two substantial complementary curved shapes, one slightly offset inward like an echo of the same self. Design the silhouette to survive a 48px phone icon. Flat pale periwinkle blue and warm ivory emblem on a solid charcoal rounded-square app tile. options.name: Shared stroke

options.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE original raster logo concept for Otherme, a personal messaging assistant that co-writes in its owner's voice under owner control.
